name: may your knives be sharp and your bullets sharper
source:
A sniper and an unconventional spotter for the covenant of the dark cross have a mission: take out an illegal blood smuggler who is poisoning vampires all across the city. The two of them engage in conversation about cats, chocolate, green tea, cassette tapes, cigarettes, and love, all while waiting, cooing to each other like bickering lovers.
